svg.title: The p99 latency of each server at fixed rates, colibri against other servers
svg.desc: p99 latency at each rate oha offers, with the bound of 10 ms. h11: colibri sustains 40,000 req/s, net/http + chi sustains 40,000 req/s, axum sustains 40,000 req/s, http.zig sustains 40,000 req/s, Fastify sustains 20,000 req/s; h2: colibri sustains 80,000 req/s, net/http + chi sustains 20,000 req/s, axum sustains 40,000 req/s, Fastify sustains 2,000 req/s; h2 over TLS: colibri sustains 40,000 req/s, net/http + chi sustains 10,000 req/s, axum sustains 40,000 req/s, Fastify sustains no rate; h3: colibri sustains 20,000 req/s, net/http + chi sustains 10,000 req/s, axum sustains 20,000 req/s.
svg.text: p99 latency at each rate oha offers, with the bound of 10 ms
oha sends GET requests over the GitHub API's routes at fixed rates, with its latency correction. A filled point is a rate
the server sustained: every answer 200, 95% of the rate reached, and p99 under 10 ms. chi is a router on Go's
net/http, and over h3 runs on quic-go, and axum on quinn. Each server runs on a core of its own. One run of bench.yml
measured all: run 44945171675, commit b00ebe04, Neoverse-N2, Linux 7.0.0-1017-azure.
